title: ATS-Friendly Resume Guidelines and Formatting Best Practices
text: Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) like Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, and Taleo parse candidate resumes into structured database fields. To ensure seamless parsing, resumes must utilize a single-column, standard layout with clear, universal headings: 'Professional Experience', 'Technical Skills', 'Education', 'Projects', and 'Summary'.

source: Executive Career Coach Resume Summary Writing Standards
title: Professional Summary Writing Guidelines
text: A compelling professional summary should be 2 to 4 concise, high-impact sentences positioned at the top of the resume. It must immediately communicate: 1) Professional Identity & Years of Experience (e.g., 'Results-driven Full Stack Engineer with 4+ years of experience...'). 2) Core Technical Specialization & Stack (e.g., 'specializing in scalable distributed systems using Node.js, Go, TypeScript, and AWS cloud architectures').
